about_the_game:
Fight, Upgrade, Die, Repeat

Experience non-stop action in Rick Henderson: Eternal Arena—a rogue-lite space shooter with a retro arcade heart. Upgrade and customize your ship, drones, and arsenal. Each run offers quick, intense battles and endless replayability for players chasing the thrill of “just one more run.”
